image_description: A close-up view of an orangutan behind a chain-link fence. The animal has characteristic reddish-brown shaggy fur and is looking towards the viewer. Its face is partially obscured by the fence mesh, but features like dark eyes and a flat nose are visible. One arm is raised, gripping the fence or hanging above, while the body appears barrel-chested.
